vulnerabilities.title: admin panel binds on 0.0.0.0 exposing it to all network interfaces
vulnerabilities.description: BIND_HOST set to 0.0.0.0 makes the admin panel reachable from any network interface. Pattern identical to CVE-2026-23744 in @mcpjam/inspector.

vulnerabilities.title: install endpoint executes npm install with attacker URL without authentication
vulnerabilities.description: HTTP GET /install?url=<pkg> triggers npm install -g <pkg> with no session, token, or origin check. Exploitable via single HTTP request from any host reaching port 8080.
